text: The cheese is not made differently from other semi-hard cheeses; it is ripened in a sealed pit, and the pit itself is part of the recipe.

steps.name: prepare pit
steps.note: Straw is burned in it to dry and sanitise it, then it is lined with straw, reeds and planks.

steps.name: bag
steps.note: The wheels are put into white cotton or linen bags, about ten to each bag.

steps.name: bury
steps.note: The pit is sealed with plaster, wood and sand in mid-to-late August.
The cheese is kept with no air to reach it, so it softens as it loses lactose, water and fat.

steps.name: unearth
steps.note: The cheeses are unearthed on St Catherine's day (25 Nov) in Sogliano, and on St Martin's (11 Nov) in Perticara.
